profile.headline: Engineering and Provisioning
profile.summary: Results-driven Software Engineer and Provisioning Specialist with over 10 years of experience in software engineering, provisioning systems, and access management across enterprise environments. Proven expertise in Conditional Access, Pay Per View, ICOMS, and system configuration management. Skilled in testing, troubleshooting, and cross-department collaboration to ensure optimal application functionality and service delivery. Recognized for innovation, quality assurance excellence, and a calm, professional approach under pressure.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
- Work with the Development and QA Teams to scale up test automation practices, and provide robust releases
- Work with the development team to establish QA best practices and identify key area to automate
- Work with the Development and QA Teams to scale up test automation practices and provide robust releases
- Create, execute, improve and maintain automation test scripts through best practices, closely monitor test results for feedback
- Develop and further maintain and improve our automation testing framework, automation tests
Create a test framework in tandem with ongoing development work
Work with architects, developers, and network and system engineers to research and identify root causes to performance issues
Experience with test automation tools and frameworks such as Application Test, API, Cucumber, Postman and other tool-sets.

positions.title: Engineer 2 - Addressability/Conditional Access
positions.description:
- Performed a variety of highly complex analytical duties in the planning, development, testing, and evaluation of Comcast's network related to the Video platform.
- Worked closely with Engineering, Head-ends and national teams on network operations to ensure proper and efficient operations of the network.
- Provided bug reports to the development engineers and work directly with developers to troubleshoot potential problem areas.
- Evaluated automated scripts and testing needs
- Supported all tools and alarms, analyze systems needs and determines priority of devices attached to the network.
- Provided operational support for the DAC/DNCS in conjunction with Engineering and AVS. 
- Supported all channel additions and changes. 
- Assist in all aspects of new system builds, troubleshooting and system conversions.
- Executed code downloads as needed to support new software and set-top hardware.
- Maintained and improved automation testing framework, automation tests
- Performed all aspects of verification, including functional, regression, and system testing
- Created test strategy, test plan, and put into execution for both UI and REST APIs
- Provided timely and transparent written status reports that highlight both successes and challenges

positions.title: Video Engineer for Cox Communications
positions.description:
● Provision, configure, deploy and support our video, data and telephony services within ICOMS interfaces. 
● Develop and maintain a deep understanding of how all of Cox products is developed, deployed and supported. 
● Support testing in the internal and external interfaces of ICOMS. 
● Quickly understand how to meet customer needs, develop solutions, create MOPs and educate other personnel within the OSS Provisioning Dept.  
● Testing and Verifying with DEV and QA teams on new and existing products and the functionality on how the product will perform from a residential and commercial perspective.  
● End to End user testing of TVOD, SVOD and PPV 
● Verifying transactions within the billing system and interfaces. 
● Performances and release testing on various set-top boxes versions in multiple environments. 
● Knowledgeable of the existing interfaces in ICOMS billing system.  
● Analyzed software bugs, provided follow ups and interacted with the developers on getting the problems fixed. 
● Coordination with Development teams, vendor for bug fixing, or new changes deployment. 
● Ensure reconciliation between one component to the other in order to identify issues early, and minimize defects. 
● Ability to handle executive escalations and other internal teams with solving complex issues 
● Support for the QA team in order to minimize developers time spent on defects related to design/ execution issues  
●	Prepared and submitted regression updates and software defect tracking reports to stakeholders as appropriate.
●	Developed automated test suites and engines.
●	Performed design reviews for continuous improvement in meeting client goals and needs.

positions.title: Senior Order Provisioning Specialist
positions.description:
●	Responsible for building streamlined provisioning and installation team for order provisioning, equipment installation, customer care, and escalation handling.
●  	Facilitated outsourced training standards and performance, consistently leading by example. Innovative and knowledgeable Customer Service and Order Processing professional a proven track record in managing overall order operations on a large scale while driving brand growth and improving sales
●  	Performed all billing system testing for new products, rate changes, new functionality, enhancements, and hyper-fixes in ICOMS and CSG billing system
●  	Analyzed and reviewed orders in applicable departments for correction and quality assurance purposes
●  	Maintained and kept rigorous quota by achieve the following marks in Revenue, Accuracy and Speed from various billing systems. 
●  	Detailed knowledgeable of Time Warner Cable and Cox Communications
●  	Assisted others agents with resolving and confirming complex orders and issues in a timely manner
●  	Ability to process, schedule, backdate, accept payments and make additional changes within ICOMS and CSG billing system

positions.title: Help Desk Support
positions.description:
● Setup and administered domain user accounts and Exchange mailboxes in Active Directory. 
● Handled purchasing new hardware for users when needed 
● Provided telephone/e-mail/voice mail support for PC hardware, software, proprietary applications, printers, etc.  
● Provided accurate and complete description of problems, inquiries and service requests in many Case Management Systems  
● Attempted to resolve all calls on the first contact to maintain a high First Contact Resolution rate  
● In addition, provided courteous, timely and professional support by phone, e-mail, remote control appliances and Instant Messaging. 
● Aided in Citrix support for users. 
● Identified priority calls and highlighted potential problems, ensuring that targets are met in line with tight key performance indicators.

positions.title: Customer Support Representative & Retail Sales Greeter
positions.description:
● Researched prospective personal and business customers' basic phone and advanced data needs. 
● Resolved customer complaints by exchanging merchandise 
● Assisted with service related functions within the Verizon Wireless Store to include: billing related inquires and issues, processing bill payments, processing credits, entering orders and activating service 
● Provided exceptional customer service that resulted in customer satisfaction which contribute to retaining 90% of Verizon Wireless customers 
● Scanned or entered new identification numbers and products structure into VZW inventory system.

positions.title: Senior Technical Support Specialist
positions.description:
● Provided answers to clients by identifying problems, researching answers and guiding clients through corrective steps. 
● Used putty and Netgear genie to remotely log into customer devices; update firmware, port forwarding, and configuring settings to increase internet speeds and stability. 
● Supported and configured wireless connectivity, as well as MS Office Suite related issues 
● Provided technical support via onsite visit, telephone, email and/or remote access to identify and resolve issues with Windows 7 OS, Cisco IP phones, wireless network printers, networking and telecommunications equipment and Hi-speed scanners 
● Assisted customers at a tier 4 level, with slow speed issues, connectivity, password reset, configuring Microsoft outlook, and virus protection. 
● Troubleshoot network connectivity using ipconfig, tracert, ping and other troubleshooting technics
